input: raw TCG PC-client binary event log
output: exact Event payload bytes as payload_hex
rules: The first record must be the legacy EV_NO_ACTION SpecID event at PCR0 with a zero SHA-1 digest.
Every subsequent event must have a complete TCG_EVENT2 header, at least one digest, and a bounded Event payload.
Digest sizes come only from the SpecID algorithm table; unknown or duplicated algorithms are DENY.
The parser preserves exact Event bytes and never hashes YAML presentation text.
The parser is independent of tpm2_eventlog YAML rendering.
payload_hex can be joined to the bounded YAML adapter and the payload-digest coherence verifier.
